## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), as the
      [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org) asks
      ([CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] Tests and docs are updated where the behaviour changed.
- [ ] If a `Cargo.lock` changed, I ran `cargo deny check` in that crate and
      refreshed its licence page, as CONTRIBUTING.md describes.
- [ ] Code taken or ported from another project is permissively licensed and
      credited in the crate's `NOTICE.md`.
- [ ] If I changed a benchmark number or a claim in the docs, it links to its
      evidence in `docs/benchmarks.md`.
